sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged under Section 376-D read with Section 506 IPC against as many as five persons.
It was alleged that in the FIR that on 15.10.2022 at about 12:00 noon, all the accused person took her from her house and committed the offence under Section 376 IPC.
Subsequently in the statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she got married to Salim and lodged an FIR against him in the year 2016.
She stated that on the date in question i.e. 15.10.2022 at about 12:00 noon, it was stated that Sharif, one of the accused, came and committed rape.
It was also stated that after Sharif, Anish came and committed the act in question.

sentences.text: prior to that at about 15 days earlier, the third and fourth accused came and committed the offence in question.
She also made similar allegations against the fifth accused.
In the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., she made allegations against applicant for the offence in question.
She did not make any allegations against Anish, Mohd. Liyas, Mohd Sharif and Nizamuddin.
The medical report is on record, which does not support the prosecution story.

3. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.
6. Considering the fact that the huge variance in the statements and the FIR and there being no corroboration in the medical report, the applicant is in custody since 08.12.2022 and has no criminal antecedents, there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Yakoob alias Kupe be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.389 of 2022,
under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Huzurpur, District Bahraich on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
